description.value: Carmana Hotel is a Canadian-owned, 96-suite boutique high-rise in Vancouver's downtown financial and shopping district, offering spacious one- and two-bedroom suites with full kitchens and floor-to-ceiling windows. Originally opened in 1999 as Carmana Plaza, it caters strongly to extended-stay guests and corporate travellers, with long-term rates available for stays of 90 days or more. It sits steps from the Stanley Park seawall, making it a practical base for cyclists exploring the city's premier waterfront cycling routes.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands (5 spaces) at 22m; stands (12 spaces, covered) at 45m; stands (2 spaces) at 57m. Total: 19 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is rich and confirms the hotel is a real, operating 96-suite boutique property in downtown Vancouver. The FAQ page explicitly describes a dedicated bike room on parking level P5, accessible via a key issued by the front office, confirming both secure storage and staff awareness of the procedure. Amenities page confirms self-serve laundry, complimentary Wi-Fi, fitness centre with Peloton bikes, gated parking, and 24-hour front desk; the FAQ confirms bikes are not permitted in suites.
concerns: OSM addr:postcode contains two values separated by a semicolon ('V6E 4R6;V6E 4H6'); website and amenities page show only V6E 4R6. The dual postcode in OSM may be an entry error and should be corrected to V6E 4R6.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating boutique hotel with confirmed secure bike storage, active booking system, and strong cyclist-relevant amenities including a dedicated bike room and on-site laundry.

Secure overnight bike storage.detail: Dedicated bike room on parking level P5; front office issues key for access. Guests must bring their own locking device

Laundry.detail: Self-serve laundry on the 3rd floor, open 24/7. Same-day professional laundry and dry-cleaning also available on request

Bikes in rooms.detail: FAQ explicitly states: 'Bikes cannot be stored inside your suite.'

Wi-Fi.detail: Complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi in all suites and public areas; login instructions and password provided at front desk on check-in

Staff know the bike procedure.detail: FAQ states 'Our front office team can issue a key for the bike room located in P5,' confirming front desk staff manage and know the bike storage process

wow_evidence: dedicated bike room on parking level P5, accessible via a key issued by the front office; self-serve laundry confirmed

price.label: Upscale
price.signal: 96-suite extended-stay high-rise with full kitchens, financial district; $240-320
